Cerebral cortical malformation caused by abnormal neuronal migration; additional organ defects are subtype-specific.

Absence of sperm is a reproductive disorder; an endocrine cause or additional organ disease is not inherent to azoospermia.
Isolated structural enlargement of the right atrial appendage; dyspnea does not establish pulmonary damage.
Inherited retinal dystrophy caused by biallelic IMPG2 variants; no additional organ involvement is established.
